config.githubRepoUrl: **Private** GitHub repository used for the backup. Accepts `https://github.com/user/repo.git`, `git@github.com:user/repo.git` or `user/repo`.
config.githubToken: **Optional.** Usually not needed: use `Claude Sync: Configure GitHub Credentials` → *Sign in with GitHub* (browser sign-in, no token). Only used as an alternative, with a Personal Access Token with the `repo` scope or a fine-grained token with *Contents: Read and write*.
config.autoSync: Enable automatic (bi-directional, lossless) sync in the background.
config.autoSyncInterval: Interval, in minutes, between automatic syncs.
config.syncOnStartup: When auto-sync is on, run a sync when VS Code opens.
welcome.remoteView:
Connect your GitHub account to keep your conversations in a private repository. No token needed.
[Sign in with GitHub](command:claudeSync.configure)
